evasoes.descricao: Moves the payload to another modality (typography in image, audio, visual perturbations) that the textual filter layer does not inspect. Includes visual payload carriers such as QR codes (R26). To convert text to image: typeset it in an editor (Canva, Microsoft Designer, Photopea) or ask an image generator for a simple white image containing only that text; then attach the image to the chat.
